mainEntity.name: Is forex trading legal in South Africa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, individuals can trade forex. Check the provider’s FSCA authorisation and, for CFDs, the issuing counterparty’s ODP status. Verify the exact entities on the official registers before depositing.

mainEntity.name: How much money do I need to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: A demo account is free. Live-account minimums vary by broker and payment method; deposit only money you can afford to lose. A low minimum does not make trading safe.

mainEntity.name: Can I use mobile money for forex trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some brokers may offer mobile-money methods. South African availability depends on the broker, country and payment provider. Confirm both deposits and withdrawals, including fees and restrictions, before registering.
